title: Torres de Satélite
notes: With Mathias Goeritz; five coloured towers on the Periférico
address: Blvd. Manuel Ávila Camacho, Ciudad Satélite, Naucalpan

detail.intro: Five concrete prisms of different heights and colours, between 30 and 52 metres tall, standing in the central reservation of the highway at the entrance to Ciudad Satélite. Made with the sculptor Mathias Goeritz, with whom Barragán had worked at El Pedregal.
